newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Liberta P loading 20,500 tonnes soymeal. Chigiria loading 30,000 tonnes soybeans. Velos loading 49,463 tonnes soymeal. Forward 2 loading 40,000 tonnes soybeans. Sotiras loading 52,000 tonnes soybeans.

Waiting to dock, 10 vessels to load soymeal, nine to load soybeans and three to load mixed cargoes (soybeans/meal). Road: 4,456 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between April 18 and 21 and 1,075 trucks with soymeal.

Loading: Paranagua loaded 510,939 tonnes in the month to April 17, compared with 357,525 tonnes in the same period last year. So far in April, it has loaded 441,729 tonnes soymeal, compared with 333,387 tonnes in the same period last year.

Vessels: Kosice loading 32,000 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, Stefania to load 28,400 tonnes soymeal, Glory Hope to load 53,000 tonnes soybeans, Horizon to load 55,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Orleta Lwowskie loading 57,855 tonnes soybeans. Finix waiting to dock, to load 24,900 tonnes soybeans.
Road: 24,570 tonnes soybeans arrived by road and rail between April 18 and 20. On April 21, 318 trucks unloaded 8,256 tonnes soybeans.
Rail: On April 21, 116 wagons unloaded 6,211 tonnes soybeans. Loading: 38,000 tonnes soybeans loaded between April 19 and 20.
